set.body:
Source: https://github.com/bbuchsbaum/natural-features/issues/11
Outcome: dependency-light musical structure descriptors, delivered in three bounded stages with separate behavioral acceptance.
Proposed paths: new src/natural_features/features/audio/music_structure.py; narrow reuse of music.py frontend; audio/__init__.py; zoo/specs/core_extractors.yaml; tests/unit/test_music_structure.py; music cookbook and CHANGELOG.md.
Stage A: audio.music.chord_profiles. Initially document 24 major/minor triad templates. Use normalized chroma-template similarities; expose profile plus score-normalized entropy, top-two margin and an explicit active/valid indicator. Use named FeatureSeries outputs through the registry's existing dictionary-output contract if separating profile and diagnostics. Call these estimates and score entropy, not chord ground truth or posterior confidence. Silence must not select an arbitrary winning chord.
Stage B: audio.music.tonal_novelty. Compute cosine distance between normalized chroma means in two explicit adjacent windows. Provide centered and past-only modes, record window duration/rounding and union of underlying waveform support. In past-only mode all preprocessing and windows must end by the output timestamp; preserve this under waveform prefix tests. Derive timing from realized sample/hop counts, not requested floating hop alone.
Stage C: audio.music.sequence_recurrence. Use normalized time-delay stacks with explicit embedding length, delay, bounded history and exclusion interval. Compare only fully supported historical candidates; exclude overlapping query/candidate spans as well as near neighbors. Emit best similarity, lag, usable-history duration/candidate count and validity. Use a bounded/blockwise implementation; validate against a small exhaustive independently written reference.
Missingness proposal: retain the native grid and publish a companion diagnostics FeatureSeries containing validity/activity, usable history and candidate counts as applicable. Use finite zero placeholders only with validity=false, and document that consumers must mask them; never interpret missing history as measured zero novelty/recurrence. Contract tests must exercise this convention through storage and alignment. Preserve warm-up duration and window support.
Acceptance: exact descriptor fixtures for triads/ambiguous mixtures; zero and near-silence; audio gain transformations away from the declared activity threshold; known tonal transitions at several scales; unchanged earlier results when future audio is appended in causal mode; repeated ordered motifs versus permutations with identical pitch-class inventories; history and exclusion boundary cases. Separate descriptor-level oracle tests from audio-frontend integration.
Scientific gate: across-genre validation on a frozen, licensed, disjoint evaluation set before neural interpretation. Synthetic correctness alone does not clear this gate. All-In-One phrase/section inference stays a separate proposal.
Next action after contract: implement chord profiles and validity behavior first, then novelty, then recurrence.
set.title: GitHub #11: add chord profiles, tonal novelty, and sequence recurrence
